verdict.rationale: GitHub's docs state that agent capabilities (agent mode, cloud agent, agent apps) are directly powered by and included in a developer's existing Copilot subscription rather than requiring a separate sign-up, e.g. 'Agent apps let you use partner-built agents directly in your workflows on GitHub, powered by your Copilot subscription' and 'Access to Cloud agent and code review' being part of the plan tiers. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the sign-in flow and explicit tier-by-tier breakdown of which subscription levels unlock agent access.
